description: DTDL Interface for the contents of `DeviceConfigs.SystemAgentDeviceConfig` in devicecfg.json. Top-level fields are Properties in contents[] with native `writable` (twin desired-property semantics). Nested shapes live in schemas[]; per-Object-field writable / required semantics are expressed in prose in each field's `description` (look for REQUIRED / OPTIONAL and 'Writable: ...'). Spec: github.com/Azure/opendigitaltwins-dtdl
comment: Properties in contents[] expose the twin surface with native `writable`; Object schemas in schemas[] describe nested JSON shapes. DTDL v2 Object fields cannot annotate `writable` / `required`, so each field states them in prose in `description`. Sensor is a sibling root in schemas[] so the Sensors Array does not breach the DTDL v2 5-level depth cap. Cross-field rules (disk MountPoint, network Interface vs Interfaces mutex, etc.) are enforced by dtdl-validate/scripts/config-rules.js.

schemas.description: Validates `Sensors[].Parameters.MetricType`. Union of every value the agent recognises.
Validates `Sensors[].SensorInfo.Schema`. Wire JSON type the agent will emit for this Sensor's Value.
Per-DeviceConfig DTDL behaviour switches. Schema for the `Dtdl` Property below.

fields.name: AutoGenEnabled
fields.description: REQUIRED. When true the agent generates a runtime DTDL Interface from Sensors[] and publishes it under the modelId envelope. When false the consumer must supply the DTDL out of band. Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

schemas.comment: Validation: Enabled is boolean; Interval is integer milliseconds in [1, 300000] (1 ms .. 5 minutes). Range enforced by the agent at config-load.

fields.name: Enabled
fields.description: REQUIRED. VALIDATION RULE: boolean. When false the Sensor is parsed but never sampled (SIL2 maintenance switch). Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

fields.name: Interval
fields.description: REQUIRED. Publishing cadence in ms. VALIDATION RULE: integer, 1 <= v <= 300000. Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

schemas.description: Union of every Parameters.* field across all MetricTypes. Cross-field validity gates (which fields go with which MetricType) are documented in the per-MetricType Interfaces 01..05 and enforced by config-rules.js.
schemas.comment: Cross-field rules: disk requires MountPoint; network's Interface/Interfaces are mutex; temperature.therm's Source/Sources are mutex; gpio.pinState's PinId/PinIds are mutex.

fields.name: MetricType
fields.description: REQUIRED. Picks the collector. VALIDATION RULE: MUST be a value from the MetricType enum. Immutable: changing it requires defining a new Sensor.

fields.name: MetricName
fields.description: REQUIRED. Sub-metric within the MetricType. VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string from the MetricType-specific allow-list in 01..05 DTDLs. Immutable.

fields.name: MountPoint
fields.description: Filesystem mount path. REQUIRED (non-empty string) when MetricType=disk; OPTIONAL and SHOULD be absent otherwise. Immutable. Enforced by config-rules.js:rules.disk.

fields.name: Interface
fields.description: Single network interface name (v1.0 / v1.1 single-iface mode). OPTIONAL. `network` MetricType only; mutex with Interfaces (config-rules.js:rules.network). Immutable.

fields.name: Interfaces
fields.description: Explicit interface list (v1.1) or auto-detect marker (empty array). OPTIONAL. `network` MetricType only; mutex with Interface. Immutable.

fields.name: Source
fields.description: Single onboard thermal source (v1.1). OPTIONAL. `temperature.therm` only; mutex with Sources. Immutable.

fields.name: Sources
fields.description: Explicit source list (v1.1) or auto-detect marker. OPTIONAL. `temperature.therm` only; mutex with Source. Immutable.

fields.name: PinId
fields.description: Single GPIO pin index. OPTIONAL. `gpio.pinState` only; mutex with PinIds. VALIDATION RULE: non-negative integer when present. Immutable.

fields.name: PinIds
fields.description: Explicit GPIO pin list (or empty for auto-detect). OPTIONAL. `gpio.pinState` only; mutex with PinId. VALIDATION RULE: Array<integer>, all non-negative. Immutable.

schemas.comment: SIL2 contract: every Sensor in devicecfg.json today has IsReadable=true and IsWritable=false (agent rejects writes).

fields.name: Schema
fields.description: REQUIRED. VALIDATION RULE: MUST be a value from the SensorInfoSchema enum AND MUST agree with the per-metric wire schema in *_FIELDS.md. Immutable: agent rejects startup on mismatch.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: REQUIRED. VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string. Long-form operator-facing description. Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.description: REQUIRED. VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string. Short UI label. Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

fields.name: IsReadable
fields.description: OPTIONAL (default true). VALIDATION RULE: MUST be true for every Sensor today (agent is read-direction). Immutable.

fields.name: IsWritable
fields.description: OPTIONAL (default false). VALIDATION RULE: MUST be false for every Sensor today (SIL2 fail-safe; agent rejects writes). Immutable.

schemas.description: Single Sensors[] entry. Declared as its own root so its tree (Sensor -> Parameters -> Array<string>) fits the DTDL v2 5-level depth cap.
schemas.comment: Validation: Name is REQUIRED unique non-empty string; SensorGroup is enum-constrained. v1.1 Sensor Expansion (network / temperature.therm / gpio.pinState) appends a suffix at runtime -- the configured Name is the base identifier.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: REQUIRED. VALIDATION RULE: non-empty ASCII string, 1..128 chars, unique within Sensors[]. Immutable: serves as the wire identifier.

fields.name: SensorGroup
fields.description: REQUIRED. VALIDATION RULE: MUST be a value from the SensorGroup enum. Immutable.

fields.name: Parameters
fields.description: REQUIRED. Collector-routing block (see SensorParameters Object). Container is immutable; individual sub-fields follow the per-MetricType DTDLs in 01..05.

fields.name: Report
fields.description: REQUIRED. Publishing cadence (see SensorReport Object). Container Writable: every sub-field is twin desired-property sync-able.

fields.name: SensorInfo
fields.description: REQUIRED. Wire-schema + display + read/write contract (see SensorInfo Object). Description / DisplayName are writable; Schema / IsReadable / IsWritable are immutable.

contents.name: Enabled
contents.description: Master enable for the agent's collectors. When false the agent loads the config but never starts sampling. Twin desired-property update is the SIL2 maintenance lever.
contents.comment: Input rule: boolean. Twin sync recommended for maintenance windows.

contents.name: Dtdl
contents.description: DTDL behaviour switches (today: AutoGenEnabled). Safe to push via twin desired-property updates.
contents.comment: Validation: must conform to the DtdlSettings Object schema.

contents.name: Sensors
contents.description: Ordered list of Sensor entries. Each element validates against the Sensor Object schema in schemas[]. Adding / removing / re-ordering Sensors is supported via twin sync; per-Sensor immutable fields (Name, MetricType, MetricName, Schema -- flagged 'Immutable' in their description) require defining a new Sensor rather than mutating an existing one.
contents.comment: Validation: array of Sensor Object instances. Empty array is valid (agent runs as heartbeat-only sub-node).
